description: Scores from the Digital Gemology Cut Performance Index for every cut we sell: overall, brilliance, fire, scintillation, tilt, symmetry, spread, shape-norm and leakage, ray traced separately in 26 gemstones (diamond, moissanite, cubic zirconia, ruby, sapphire, emerald, amethyst, topaz, spinel, demantoid, zircon, tourmaline, peridot, tanzanite, YAG, pyrope, almandine, spessartine, grossular, chrysoberyl, kunzite, iolite, morganite, GGG, strontium titanate and synthetic rutile), with each cut's place in its material. Filter by cut, category or material; with no filter, every row. Figures are unrounded. Never compare or rank scores across materials. Ruby and sapphire share one refractive index, so the same figures; material_notes lists the other stones that share figures and the doubling caveats. Cuts not yet scored come with the reason.

category.description: brilliants, jewelry, historic, house or platonic.

cut.description: The cut's slug or name, for example 'oval' or 'DG-M5'.

material.description: One stone, as its slug; leave it out for all 26. An alias stone returns the rows of the stone it shares optical constants with, and says so.

name: get_cut_scores
title: Cut Performance Index scores
